v3_changes.requirements: Reception dashboard: four operational counts, immediate shortcuts, actionable appointment preview
Queue status/arrival cards, check-in action and doctor handoff with accurate state mapping
Optional token display board, ticket assignment and waiting-time analytics; separate queue backend required
Appointment day/week calendar, doctor filters, prominent availability and conflict validation
Appointment Kanban mode as a switchable presentation of the same backend records
Appointment request inbox for manually received phone/walk-in requests; no patient portal assumed
Patient summary card, latest vitals with source date, last visit and clinical history timeline
Patient photo/consent summary anchored in patient profile; retain original non-destructive annotation requirements
Doctor My Day: next patient primary action, pending drafts/results/follow-ups and own availability
Doctor visit workspace uses status-aware guidance, patient header and one entry for history/exam; no new clinical data duplication
Lab worklist: pending collection/sent/received/reviewed states with manual external-lab provider mapping
Lab report upload panel with test linkage, privacy, review and attachment provenance
Nurse/assistant assigned tasks and vitals; omit ward, bed, ICU and automatic alerts
Pharmacy dashboard: shortages, expiring stock, outstanding purchase items and quick transaction access
Expired/7/30/90-day expiry urgency and drilldown by item, warehouse, available batch quantity
Value at risk based on verified current valuation and usable balance; no fabricated figures
Stock balance KPI: positive/onhand vs usable, low/out-of-stock and per-location filters
Low-stock row to prefilled draft PO/replenishment handoff; actual ERPNext document lifecycle
PO partial-receipt progress, expected arrival and supplier source; ERPNext statuses authoritative
Controlled stock adjustment and transfer: reason, source transaction, permission and confirm; never direct-write quantity
Cashier due/pending and same-day cash/card collection summaries with drilldowns to posted entries
Manager dashboard: appointment funnel, visit completion, doctor availability, invoices vs collected payments
Revenue by invoice service item/treatment category when source mapping proven; avoid asserting clinical procedure revenue
Staff working days/hours, break periods and availability policies mapped to practitioner schedule
Role-aware notifications and actionable work items, with authorized navigation and dismissed/read state
Icon-led primary actions, compact status chips, consistent master/detail and mobile stacked cards
TH/EN across new labels, badges, alerts, calendar, graphs and print; preserves v2 draft/locale guarantees
All interactive PreClinic examples are reference patterns only; installed Frappe contracts remain unverified
Exclude hospital wards/beds, AI diagnosis, patient risk scoring, CRM, telehealth, payroll, insurance, marketing and social modules
Acceptance tests for duplicate check-in, stale queue, expired stock, transaction retry and permission-safe UX
Reception-to-cashier handoff with unpaid/paid state, no clinical-note exposure and authorized follow-up booking
